paragraphs.text: Laelia , also known as the Blade Reforged , is a spirit warrior affiliated with Strixhaven University on the plane of Arcavios .

Upon awakening as a spirit, Laelia was overcome with anger upon realizing she had died long ago. Though she could not seek vengeance against the soldiers who had betrayed her in life, she channeled her fury into a new purpose. Laelia founded a dueling club at Strixhaven, where she dedicates herself to training students in the discipline and mastery of magical combat, passing on her knowledge and skills to the next generation of warriors.

MTG Japan's 2026 April Fools' "Strixhaven University: Japan Branch" included a location called "Laelia's Dueling Club" with the motto "You do not talk about Laelia's Dueling Club." The location and its motto are a reference to the 1999 film Fight Club .
